stories.summaryEn: Promise Me, America was published just before the former US president’s 84th birthday as he battles advanced cancer In a new memoir, Joe Biden offers harsh criticism of Volodymyr Zelenskyy , who has led Ukraine through four and a half years of war against Russia. stories.narrEn: PBS NewsHour reports: Almost two years after leaving office, former President Joe Biden has penned a memoir about his time in the White House. The Guardian reports: Promise Me, America was published just before the former US president’s 84th birthday as he battles advanced cancer In a new memoir, Joe Biden offers harsh criticism of Volodymyr Zelenskyy , who has led Ukraine through four and a half years of war against Russia. PBS NewsHour reports: "Promise Me, America," is out, but Biden isn't out doing the typical run of media interviews.
